_comment: Model-boundary exceptions. Vault-relative path prefixes that are gitignored (never sync) but that the model MAY read - use when an agreement permits AI tools on material you still keep off your remote. Case-insensitive prefix match. Empty list = the original rule: if git will not sync it, the model does not see it.
_remote_login: The one Tailscale login the interface admits from off this machine, once `tailscale serve` proxies port 8787 (interface/backend/access.py). Compared case-insensitively against the Tailscale-User-Login header Serve stamps on every proxied request. Missing or empty = every remote request is refused. Restart sigma ui after editing.
